_meta.facet: Once Human food, drinks and consumable combat buffs, including stacking rules
_meta.gameVersion: Primary numbers: Taiwanese community sheet '七日世界.xlsx' (料理 tab) snapshot imported 2026-05-17 (covers Manibus/Evolution's Call, Way of Winter, Eternal Dream, Sky Touch, Branch Path scenarios; Chefosaurus Rex Azure Melody event Jul 2025). Cross-checks: English wikis/guides 2024-07 to 2025 (fandom Buffs and Effects, Steam guide 3339574420, TheGamer, gamerant, Game8). Current Oct-2026 season name not determined.
_meta.units: percent = plain number meaning percent (25 => +25%); flat = absolute points; seconds = seconds; state = on/off effect with no number
_meta.notes: WebFetch to all wiki/guide domains and WebSearch quota were blocked/exhausted during this session; the 84-row TW sheet (hosted in GitHub repo TeeReckzi/OHMM) was read in full in Chinese and hand-translated; English values come from WebSearch result summaries of the listed pages. Items from the sheet carry confidence 'high' when at least one English source agrees, 'medium' when only the sheet gives the value. Items with buffs:null could not be found. durationSeconds is the base duration (English sources: 30 min for most combat/gathering buffs, 60 min for survival/resist buffs); durationAtStardustFusionStoveSeconds is the sheet's value for dishes cooked at the top-tier Stardust Fusion Stove (x1.75). chefRexBoostedPower is the sheet's 青龍 column = effect value with a Chefosaurus Rex (rating 5, activity >=90, +38%) territory deviation.

stackingRules.slotModel: One active FOOD buff + one active DRINK buff at a time (default). Eating another food replaces the current food buff; drinking another drink replaces the current drink buff (same-slot overwrite). Food and drink buffs stack with each other.
evidence: Steam discussion 'How do food or drinks stack?' (4514379914253028765): 'If food buffs take the same buff slot they will overwrite. Each of those little circles at the bottom can hold 1 buff.'
OHMM calculator (TeeReckzi/OHMM, 2026) models the loadout as exactly { food: id, drink: id } and applies both simultaneously (loadoutEffectResolver.ts).

Chef class 'Glutton' talent description (Game8/theriagames/bisecthosting 2025): 'consume additional food and drink, gaining up to 2 food effects and 2 drink effects at the same time' — implies the non-Chef baseline is 1 food + 1 drink.
Steam guide 3339574420 labels each buff with a type (Combat / Survival / Gathering); whether differently-typed FOOD buffs can coexist is NOT confirmed — treat as one food slot.
stackingRules.additiveWithOtherSources: Food percentages are assumed additive with same-named stat bonuses from gear/mods (standard Once Human stat bucketing); not independently verified for food.
stackingRules.specialEffectsNotInSlots: Unknown whether 'Whim'-type effects (Skybound double jump, Full Stomach from Stardust Tea, body-size changes) occupy the food/drink buff slot — open question.

ingredientSubBuffs.description: Dishes whose recipe takes a generic 'Meat (any)', 'Fish', 'Fruit (any)', 'Egg' or 'Milk' get a small extra buff depending on the specific ingredient used (sheet column 食材效果). The only numeric table found is for Canned Lunch Meat (fandom).

cannedLunchMeatTable.Deer Meat: DMG +2% vs targets under The Bull's Eye

ingredientSubBuffs.appliesToOtherMeatDishes: Likely (fandom says Honey Glazed Meat, Mixed Fried Hot Dog, Bone-In Deviated Sausage have meat-dependent bonuses) but values unverified; Pristine meats may give larger values (unverified).

chefosaurusRex.description: Chefosaurus Rex (青龍) territory deviation: 'Boosts the effect of food cooked by the player; the higher its Ability Rating the stronger the boost.' Multiplies the dish's effect power (e.g., Stargazy Pie 25% -> 34.5% at +38%). Variants Azure Melody and Berserkosaurus Rex have the same ability.
chefosaurusRex.unit: percent increase of the food effect value (multiplicative on the dish value, not additive to the stat)
chefosaurusRex.ohmmNote: OHMM hardcodes 'common bonus 38%, max observed 42%' — the 42% is not in the TW sheet (max there is 38%); treat 42% as unverified.

cookingStationDuration.description: The TW sheet lists buff durations 'at the Stardust Fusion Stove' of 52.5 min for dishes whose English-wiki duration is 30 min, 105 min for 60-min survival buffs, 26.25 for 15-min, 17.5 for 10-min — i.e., the top-tier stove multiplies buff duration by 1.75. Whether lower stoves give intermediate multipliers is unknown.

stackingRules.conditionalBuffs: Several top damage foods are conditional: Stargazy Pie requires Energy bar full; Assorted Canned Fruit requires Sanity > 80%; Butter Matsutake's 12% requires both Energy and Hydration full; Stardust Tea keeps Energy/Hydration full for 2 h and is the standard way to hold those conditions.
